Model 4 - comparison between methods
```{r}

library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
getHdata(gusto)
gusto.dat <- gusto

set.seed(4176340)

gusto.dat <- gusto[which(gusto$grpl %in% c(1,2,4) & gusto$grps %in% c(5,9,10,11)),]
```

variables model 4:

```{r}
gusto.dat$PUL <- gusto.dat$pulse
gusto.dat$AGE <- gusto.dat$age
gusto.dat$SYS <- gusto.dat$sysbp


#simulate two asymmetric continuous predictors
gusto.dat$V_1 <- rlnorm(n = nrow(gusto.dat),
  meanlog = log(gusto.dat$sysbp),
  sdlog = 0.5)

gusto.dat$V_2 <- rexp( n = nrow(gusto.dat), rate= 1/gusto.dat$sysbp)

cor(gusto.dat$V_1, gusto.dat$SYS) #correlation predictor V1 and outcome
cor(gusto.dat$V_2, gusto.dat$SYS) #correlation predictor V2 and outcome

```



Cross validation function - Model 4
```{r}

#algorithm:
fold_k5 <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out= nrow(gusto.dat))) #index per fold

#function(threshold)
Cross_val_local_shrik <- function(neff) { 
  form1 <- SYS ~ V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL
  mse <- rep(0,5)

  for(i in 1:5){
    train <- gusto.dat[fold_k5 != i, ] 
    test  <- gusto.dat[fold_k5 == i, ]
  
   #per each train set
    mod_OLS_base <- lm(formula = form1, data = train)
    X_ols <- model.matrix(~ V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL, data= train)  
    XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols
    
    relvar_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols)) #effective sample size
     for(j in 1:length(relvar_OLS)){
      relvar_OLS[j] <- (t(X_ols[j,])%*%solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[j,])}
    
    Z_ols      <- X_ols[,-1] #predictors without intercept
    n          <- nrow(Z_ols) 
    Z_shrink   <- Z_ols    #copy of the covariates that will be shrank
    relvar_it  <- relvar_OLS #copy of hii
    z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink)  #average per predictor
    zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) #covariates are centered
    X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink) #design matrix + intercept 
    iter       <- 0 
    maxiter    <- 1000
    dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  #distance
    diststart  <- dist  # initial distance saved
  
    max_dist <- n*1/neff-1
  
 
    Cov <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink)
    
    while(max(dist) > max_dist & iter < maxiter){ #while loop until all distances are below the threshold
  

      distshrink  <- dist 
      distshrink[which(dist>max_dist)] <- max_dist #shrinkage of dist>max_dist
  

      a           <- sqrt(distshrink/dist) # compute shrinkage factor
  
      azc         <- a*zc  #shrinkage of the centered covariates
      Z_shrink    <- t(apply(X=azc, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) #adding the mean 
  
      iter <- iter + 1  
 
      X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)  #adding the intercept to the shrunk predictors
   
      z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink) # calculating the mean 
  
      zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar}))
  
      Cov        <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) #compute inverse XTX with shrunk X
  
      relvar_it  <- diag(X_shrink %*% Cov %*% t(X_shrink))  
  
      n_eff      <- 1/relvar_it
  
      dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
      }


  train_shrunk <- data.frame("SYS" = train$sysbp) 
  train_shrunk <- cbind(train_shrunk, Z_shrink)
  mod_train_shrink <- lm(formula = form1, data = train_shrunk )
  
  #per each test:
  X_ols_test <- model.matrix(~ V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL, data= test)
  relvar_OLS_test <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_test))  
  for(k in 1:length(relvar_OLS_test)){
    relvar_OLS_test[k] <- (t(X_ols_test[k,])%*%Cov%*%X_ols_test[k,])}
  
  n.test <- nrow(X_ols_test)
  test_distance <- n*relvar_OLS_test-1 
  
  distshrink_test <- pmin(test_distance, max_dist)
  a_test <-  sqrt(distshrink_test / test_distance) #test set shrinkage factor
  
  Z_ols_test   <- X_ols_test[,-1] 
  Z_shrink_test <- Z_ols_test 
  relvar_it_test <- relvar_OLS_test

  zc_test        <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
  
  azc_test <-zc_test*a_test#shrinking the test set covariates 
  Z_shrink_test    <- t(apply(X=azc_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) 
  X_shrink_test <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n.test), Z_shrink_test) 
  
  

  #compute MSE
  test_shrunk <- data.frame("SYS" = test$sysbp) 
  test_shrunk <- cbind(test_shrunk, Z_shrink_test)

  dim(Z_shrink)
  pred <- predict(mod_train_shrink, newdata = test_shrunk)
  
  mse[i] <-  mean((test$sysbp- pred)^2)}
  
  return(mean(mse))
}
```

grid search
```{r}
grid_neff <- c(0,50,120,150) #candidates
mse_values <- sapply(grid_neff, function(x) { Cross_val_local_shrik(neff = x) }) 
results <- data.frame( neff = grid_neff, MSE = mse_values ) 
best <- results[which.min(results$MSE), ] 
results
best  #120

Cross_val_local_shrik(neff = 0) #MSE for OLS


```

CV ridge regression
```{r}
x.4 <- model.matrix( ~ V_1 + V_2 +AGE + PUL , gusto.dat)[,-1] 
y.4 <- gusto.dat$SYS

cv_ridge.4 <- cv.glmnet( x.4, y.4, alpha = 0, lambda = c(1, 0.5,0.1,0.05,0.02,0.01, 0),nfolds = 5,keep = T, foldid = fold_k5  )

cv_ridge.4$lambda.min #0.5

j <- which(cv_ridge.4$lambda == 0.5)

#predictions out of fold
pred <- cv_ridge.4$fit.preval[, j]

# MSE per fold
mse_fold <- sapply(1:5, function(i) {
  idx <- fold_k5 == i
  mean((y.4[idx] - pred[idx])^2)
})

mean(mse_fold)

```

size = 0.7

# build test and training sets.
# parameter : size        'training size'

train_index <- sample(1:n.1, size = size * n.1)
train_set <- gusto.dat[train_index, ]
test_set  <- gusto.dat[-train_index, ]

train_set$pat.id <- 1:n_pat

train_set$SYS <- train_set$sysbp
train_set$AGE <- train_set$age
train_set$PUL <- train_set$pulse


test_set$SYS <- test_set$sysbp
test_set$AGE <- test_set$age

Local shrinkage predictions - model 4

Train set:
```{r}
X_ols <- model.matrix(~AGE+PUL + V_1 + V_2, data= train_set)  
X_ols_test <- model.matrix(~AGE+PUL + V_1 + V_2, data= test_set) 

XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols
relvar_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols))  
for(i in 1:length(relvar_OLS)){
  relvar_OLS[i] <- (t(X_ols[i,])%*%solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[i,])
} 

Z_ols      <- X_ols[,-1] 
n          <- nrow(Z_ols) 
Z_shrink   <- Z_ols   
relvar_it  <- relvar_OLS 
z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink)  
zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)  
iter       <- 0 
maxiter    <- 1000
dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
diststart  <- dist 

neff_min <- 120 #optimal threshold
max_dist <- n*(1/neff_min) -1

#loop:
while(max(dist) > max_dist & iter < maxiter){ #while loop until all distances are below the threshold
  

  distshrink  <- dist
  distshrink[which(dist>max_dist)] <- max_dist #if dist > max_dist , dist is shrank
  
  
  a           <- sqrt(distshrink/dist) #shrinkage factor train set
  
  
  azc         <- a*zc #shrinkage of train set covariates
  Z_shrink    <- t(apply(X=azc, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar}))  
  
  iter <- iter + 1  
 
  X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)  
  
  z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink) 
  
  zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar}))
  
  
  Cov        <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) #recompute inverse XTX with shrunk X 
  
  relvar_it  <- diag(X_shrink %*% Cov %*% t(X_shrink))
  
  n_eff      <- 1/relvar_it 
  
  dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
}


train_shrunk <- data.frame("SYS" = train_set$sysbp) 

train_shrunk <- cbind(train_shrunk, Z_shrink) #dataframe with weight observed and shrunk train covariates

mod_OLS_shrunk <- lm(formula = form1, data = train_shrunk) #linear regression with shrunk train covariates

```


Test set
```{r}
relvar_OLS_test <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_test))  
for(i in 1:length(relvar_OLS_test)){
  relvar_OLS_test[i] <- (t(X_ols_test[i,])%*%Cov%*%X_ols_test[i,])
}
sum((1/relvar_OLS_test)<120) #computing the number of shrunk subjects 

n.test <- nrow(X_ols_test)
test_distance <- n*relvar_OLS_test-1

distshrink_test <- pmin(test_distance, max_dist)

a_test <-  sqrt(distshrink_test / test_distance) #test set shrinkage factor

Z_ols_test   <- X_ols_test[,-1] 

Z_shrink_test <- Z_ols_test 

relvar_it_test <- relvar_OLS_test

zc_test        <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 

azc_test <-zc_test*a_test #shrinkage of test set

Z_shrink_test    <- t(apply(X=azc_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) 

X_shrink_test <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n.test), Z_shrink_test)
```


Ridge predictions on test set:
```{r}
x_train <- model.matrix( ~  AGE + PUL +  V_1 + V_2, train_set)[,-1] 
y_train <- train_set$SYS
x_test <- model.matrix( ~  AGE + PUL +  V_1 + V_2, test_set)[,-1] 
y_test <- test_set$SYS

mod_train_ridge <- glmnet(x= x_train, y= y_train, alpha = 0,lambda = 0.85)

ridgePRED <- predict(mod_train_ridge, newx= x_test)


```


Visualization:

Predictions: OLS vs Local shrinkage
```{r}

test_shrunk <- data.frame("SYS" = test_set$sysbp) 
test_shrunk <- cbind(test_shrunk, Z_shrink_test) 


pred_local_test <- predict(mod_OLS_shrunk,newdata= test_shrunk) #predictions local shrinkage
pred_ols <- predict(mod_OLS_base, newdata = test_set) #predictions OLS

ggplot(
  data = data.frame(pred_ols = pred_ols,
                    pred_local_test = pred_local_test),
  aes(x = pred_ols, y = pred_local_test)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "OLS predictions",
    y = "Local shrinkage predictions"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
